utral word lists and the word groups are from my own knowledge, guided by the description. Synonyms such as `man`/`men` count as the same member of a group.
- **One judgement call:** I read the conflict rule literally. A hypothesis word scores a conflict if the premise contains any other member of its group, even when the premise also contains the word itself. The rest of the gap to 63.5% probably comes from these word-list choices.
